title: Operational credit runway and headcount staggered curve
summary: A compact working workbook outlining a 9-month operational runway model that ties available customer credit balances and committed reserved capacity to a staggered hiring curve. Purpose: give S&M / Ops a pragmatic trigger map for converting credits to burst capacity vs. hiring FTEs while preserving margin under 3 pricing shock scenarios.
key_assumptions: Net new committed ARR decelerates 12% q/q starting Jan 2027 in base case
Average token intensity per customer remains flat; top 20% customers drive 62% of burst demand
On-demand GPU spot pricing volatility band: +/- 28% over 3 months
Credit conversion efficacy (credits->burst capacity) = 0.72 due to lead time and minimum-pool sizing
Hiring lead time (SWE/infra) = 10 weeks; ramp to full productivity = 16 weeks
sensitivity_matrix:
Matrix keyed on two levers: price floor change (±15%) and credit conversion efficacy (0.6 / 0.8). Outcomes:
- Price -15%, conv 0.6 -> runway compresses by ~2.3 months relative to base; emergency hiring freeze recommended.
- Price -15%, conv 0.8 -> runway compresses by ~1.1 months; prioritize converting credits to burst instead of hiring.
- Price +15%, conv 0.6 -> runway extends ~1.2 months; use reserve to support strategic hires.
- Price +15%, conv 0.8 -> runway extends ~2.6 months; modest hiring + 25% burst pool recommended.
Notes: sensitivity assumes proportional impact on spot cost and a lagged effect on customer token consumption (4–6 weeks).
recommended_triggers: If starting credits < $0.5M and 2-month runway remaining -> institute hiring freeze for non-critical roles and move product roadmap items to quarterly backlog
If spot cost increases > 20% vs trailing 12-week avg -> throttle burst pools by 30% and notify top-20 customers with temporary rate discounts (short-window)
If conversion efficacy tests (pilot) show >0.78 -> accelerate 6-week burst purchase program and delay 2 planned infra hires
If committed ARR downtick > 18% q/q -> prepare a 12% discretionary cost reduction bundle for SRE/tooling and delay non-customer-facing hiring
action_items:
1) Run a 4-week credit-to-burst pilot for top-5 customers (owner: Priya)

3) Update hiring pipeline to include 'staggered start' slots and 4-week float offers (owner: Talent Ops)
4) Instrument console to report token intensity by customer cohort weekly (owner: Observability)
5) Finance to publish a rolling 6-week runway readout every Monday
open_questions: How do we surface credit expiration incentives without encouraging gaming?
What's the expected uplift to conversion efficacy if we offer 30-day burst buckets vs ad-hoc credits?
Can we legally move credits between regions (APAC -> NA) to optimize runway under regional price spikes?
What SLA/penalty exposure arises if we throttle burst pools for existing enterprise customers?
approval_needed: Finance lead sign-off required on pilot budget (estimated $220k) and product permission to run slab price experiment. Exec review requested if runway < 2 months on next weekly financial snapshot.
notes_to_pm: This is a tactical working sheet, not a public exec deck. Keep sensitive numbers internal. Use this as the primary input for the Dec 7 cross-functional ops review. Expect frequent updates as pilot telemetry arrives.
